rule: Without an explicit preference, enable a source only when its application identity appears in the startup installation snapshot.
installation_snapshot_refreshed: on process startup; restart after installing or uninstalling an app
coverage: Missing apps are off; installed application variants match one source
Implicit defaults are recomputed after restart and never become explicit choices through another source's save
Explicit on/off and custom paths survive installation-state changes
Leftover metadata files do not count as an installed application
Uninstalled implicit actions are absent from global search and shortcut targets; explicit toggles republish the same registry
Existing parser and lifecycle fixtures use synthetic installation snapshots
